Created a std-only Rust 2021 project in [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml:1) with the entrypoint at [test5.rs](/output/test5.rs:1). The binary collects `std::env::args()` and ignores argv, matching the C++ program’s observable CLI behavior, then runs the same four boolean-op calls and prints the intersection path count. The supporting library code is under [types.rs](/output/src/clipper2/types.rs:1), [rect.rs](/output/src/clipper2/rect.rs:1), and [ops.rs](/output/src/clipper2/ops.rs:1).

I built it with `rustc --edition=2021 /output/test5.rs -o /output/test5` and `cargo build --release`. The executable at `/output/test5` prints exactly `1` with no args and with extra args, matching `/workspace/dataset/test5_executable`.
